$comment: The permissions vocabulary (platform plan 3.2): the fixed enum shown on the install prompt (docs/UI.md pattern table > Permission prompt). Entries ending in a colon take a parameter (a host, an action kind, a package id, a path); literal entries do not.

permissions.description: Reach this specific host through host.fetch.
Read the speaker's name, not just their id and role.
Emit an action of this kind via host.action.emit.

Call host.home.call_service for services in this specific Home Assistant domain. Never grantable as a wildcard - a manifest must name each domain it needs, and a security domain (lock, alarm_control_panel, cover, garage_door, valve) additionally requires the manifest to declare consequential: true.
Call this specific integration through host.integration.call.
Read or write this path through host.files.
